# Tenmat

> Tenmat provides fire barrier products and tools for selecting the right fire protection solutions for construction and industrial applications.

Tenmat specializes in fire barrier technology and offers a product finder tool to help customers identify the most suitable fire protection products based on their specific criteria and requirements.

## Key Topics

- Fire Barrier Products
- Product Selector
- VFB Plus
- VFB 120/120
- VFB 60/60
- Non Ventilated Fire Barrier
- CavGuard Roll 65
- FF102/50
- FF102/25
- Product Finder
- Criteria Matching
- Fire Protection

## Product Selection Tools

- [Tenmat Product Finder](https://productselector.tenmat.com): Interactive tool for selecting fire barrier products by criteria and application requirements
